email.layout.footer: You received this email because of your RejectRadar account.
email.layout.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
email.verify.subject: Verify your email for RejectRadar
email.verify.heading: Verify your email address
email.verify.body: Hi {name}, confirm this address to finish setting up your RejectRadar account.
email.verify.expiry: The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
email.reset.subject: Reset your RejectRadar password
email.reset.heading: Reset your password
email.reset.body: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset the password of your RejectRadar account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
email.reset.expiry: The link works once and expires in 1 hour.
email.invite.subject: {inviterName} invited you to {orgName} on RejectRadar
email.invite.heading: You are invited to {orgName}
email.invite.body: {inviterName} invited you to join {orgName} on RejectRadar as {role}.
email.invite.expiry: The link works once and expires in 7 days.
email.accountExists.subject: You already have a RejectRadar account
email.accountExists.heading: You already have an account
email.accountExists.body: Someone tried to sign up for RejectRadar with this email address, but an account already exists. You can log in, or reset your password if you have forgotten it.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: Something in your request is not valid. Check the details and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you asked for.
errors.CONFLICT: This conflicts with the current state. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.UNPROCESSABLE: We could not process those details. Check them and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: RejectRadar is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: Something went wrong with that request. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.DB_UNAVAILABLE: We cannot reach our data right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.CSRF_MISSING: We could not confirm this action came from you. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.INVALID_SESSION: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.REFRESH_RACE: Your session was just renewed. Please try again.
errors.EMAIL_CAP_REACHED: We have reached today's limit for sending emails. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.COMMON_PASSWORD: That password is too common. Choose a different one.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email address to do this.
errors.NO_MEMBERSHIP: Your account does not belong to an organization. Ask for an invitation to join one.
errors.LAST_OWNER: An organization must keep at least one owner.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the organization.
errors.ALREADY_IN_ACCOUNT: You already belong to another organization.
errors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached your plan's limit for this. Upgrade your plan to continue.
errors.PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED: This feature is not included in your plan. Upgrade your plan to use it.
